title.text: The admin evaluates the software based on:- Security risk (malware history, remote access ability, encryption bypass)- Data protection implications (GDPR relevance, telemetry, cloud connections)- License / legal concerns- Compliance guidelines- Technical stability impact- Business need vs risk

details.comment: I think this is also part of the discussion of PV and PV-Light or what responsibilities a PV should have for the tool. Even though there are different discussions and concept from different stakeholders proposed but no final and official documentation is done.
